sentences: The T# FORMAT selects the sampled image type, and every type uses the LOD following the two coordinates.
Vulkan requires the sampled type and signedness to match the view.

The CPU test in `tests/test_image_load_typed.py` checks the R32 UINT, SINT and FLOAT descriptor branches, the float fallback on a lookup miss and the LOD register with full-width and D16 results. [Vulkan sampling validation](https://docs.vulkan.org/spec/latest/chapters/textures.html#textures-input-validation)
